typography.installation: Ensure fonts are imported via Google Fonts or Fontshare in index.css

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: High-density control room with bento grid structure. Every pixel utilized.

grid.kpi_summary: col-span-1 lg:col-span-3 grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4

buttons.primary: bg-[#E2FF00] text-black font-bold tracking-wide rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#CBE600] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E2FF00]/50
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white font-medium rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors

inputs.base: bg-black border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 text-white placeholder:text-neutral-600 focus:border-[#E2FF00] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E2FF00] font-mono text-sm
inputs.labels: text-xs font-semibold text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5 block

tables.header: text-xs font-semibold text-neutral-500 uppercase tracking-wider text-left pb-3 border-b border-white/10

kpi_metrics.label: text-xs text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-widest font-semibold
kpi_metrics.trend_up: text-[#00E676] bg-[#00E676]/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-medium
kpi_metrics.trend_down: text-[#FF3B30] bg-[#FF3B30]/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-medium

icons_and_assets.style: duotone or regular weight for UI elements

empty_state_chart.description: Optional: Generate a CSS-based subtle radial gradient or grid pattern background for the empty state instead of an image.

testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters) and key informational elements (KPI values, table rows) MUST include kebab-case 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="run-simulation-button"', 'data-testid="kpi-net-pnl"').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a dark mode dashboard. Do not use generic light theme.
Install and use the specified font families (Cabinet Grotesk for Headings, Satoshi for body, JetBrains Mono for all numbers and data tables).
Build a Left Sidebar (col-span-1) for 'Strategy Parameters' and Main Content Area (col-span-3) for Results in a 4-col lg grid.
Use Recharts for the Equity Curve chart. Style the line with stroke='#E2FF00' and a subtle gradient fill below the line.
Ensure all financial values in tables and KPI cards use the JetBrains Mono font class to ensure numbers align perfectly.
Positive P&L must be colored #00E676 and Negative P&L must be colored #FF3B30.
Apply data-testid to every filter input, the 'Run Simulation' button, each KPI card value, and table rows.
